mapper.sql: m.id, m.chat_room_id, m.sender_id, m.sender_type, m.message_type, m.content, m.image_key, m.image_original_name, m.image_content_type, m.image_size, m.action_type, m.action_url, m.client_message_id, m.created_at, CASE WHEN m.sender_type = 'CUSTOMER' THEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM chat_message_reads customer_read WHERE customer_read.chat_message_id = m.id AND customer_read.member_id != m.sender_id ) WHEN m.sender_type = 'ADMIN' THEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM chat_message_reads admin_read JOIN chat_rooms read_room ON read_room.id = m.chat_room_id WHERE admin_read.chat_message_id = m.id AND admin_read.member_id = read_room.customer_id ) ELSE 0 END AS is_read
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_rooms SET status = 'OPEN', closed_at = NULL WHERE id = #{roomId} AND status = 'CLOSED'
UPDATE chat_rooms SET status = 'CLOSED', closed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{roomId} AND status = 'OPEN'

sql.if: AND ( SELECT ordinary.sender_type FROM chat_messages ordinary WHERE ordinary.chat_room_id = r.id AND ordinary.message_type IN ('TEXT', 'IMAGE') ORDER BY ordinary.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) = 'CUSTOMER'

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_rooms r WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT r.id AS room_id, r.customer_id, r.status, r.last_message_at, latest.id AS last_message_id, CASE WHEN latest.message_type = 'IMAGE' AND NULLIF(latest.content, '') IS NULL THEN '이미지' WHEN latest.message_type = 'SYSTEM_CARD' THEN '주문제작 안내' ELSE LEFT(latest.content, 120) END AS last_message_preview, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_messages unread WHERE unread.chat_room_id = r.id AND unread.sender_type = 'CUSTOMER' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM chat_message_reads read_marker WHERE read_marker.chat_message_id = unread.id ) ) AS unread_count, COALESCE(( SELECT ordinary.sender_type = 'CUSTOMER' FROM chat_messages ordinary WHERE ordinary.chat_room_id = r.id AND ordinary.message_type IN ('TEXT', 'IMAGE') ORDER BY ordinary.id DESC LIMIT 1 ), 0) AS is_unanswered FROM chat_rooms r LEFT JOIN chat_messages latest ON latest.id = ( SELECT last_message.id FROM chat_messages last_message WHERE last_message.chat_room_id = r.id ORDER BY last_message.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY r.last_message_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
